summary: Tests-only (red-phase) run for issue #39. Added the committed solver parity corpus (upstream viamin/color_matching PR #112) plus a permanent replay test that asserts WeightedSquaredErrorScorer scores, selection, error and tie evidence match the corpus exactly; added an OpenAPI contract test that pins the document the typed client is generated from and the documented endpoint/response shapes; extended the API client tests with documented-path and disk-cache/offline-fallback coverage; documented corpus and OpenAPI consumption under docs/. The Swift toolchain is not available in this container, so no Swift test could be executed here: the corpus replay equivalence was instead verified with an independent IEEE-754 double implementation of the mirrored rules (all 12 scenarios match exactly). The OpenAPI contract tests are expected to fail until the implementation lands (no OpenAPI document, no swift-openapi-runtime dependency, no generated client yet).
